expectations.text: Eruptibility: actors and pressures are already in motion when PCs arrive
expectations.evidence: A dispute is 'in formal process — in the quiet stage before the duel.' Forces are active: the Arrived Dispute and the Site Itself are both moving. The ceremony is underway when PCs arrive.

expectations.text: At least two factions or actors at Corvenna have independent agendas
expectations.evidence: Two forces named: The Arrived Dispute (parties with wants, champions ready) and The Site Itself (Unknown Authorities maintaining neutrality). Each has independent wants and next moves.

expectations.text: Visible tells exist that the party can notice without asking
expectations.evidence: 'Quiet formal gathering; two separated groups; preliminary ceremony; no one volunteers details' — all observable without asking. 'Someone is clearly orchestrating it despite no named authority being present.'

expectations.text: Situation advances if the party does nothing — consequences of inaction visible
expectations.evidence: Reactivity section: 'The duel happens on schedule unless physically stopped. The winner is determined by actual combat. The loser either accepts the result or the site's authorities enforce it.' Clear independent timeline.

expectations.text: No specific NPC question or trigger gates all discovery
expectations.evidence: Four routes: Direct Inquiry, Observation & Investigation, Refusal/Interference, Walk Away. Discovery through observation alone (Route 2) doesn't require asking anyone.

expectations.text: Content grounded in established Corvenna wiki facts
expectations.evidence: Uses Corvenna's established facts: neutral ground, champion combat, unknown authorities, eastern reef location, dispute resolution purpose.
